items.title: COVID-19 impacts on anthropogenic NOx emissions in China, the contiguous U.S., and Europe: insights from joint TROPOMI and surface NO2 data assimilation
items.title_en: COVID-19 impacts on anthropogenic NOx emissions in China, the contiguous U.S., and Europe: insights from joint TROPOMI and surface NO2 data assimilation
items.title_zh: 新冠疫情对中国、美国本土及欧洲的人为氮氧化物（NOx）排放的影响：基于TROPOMI与地表二氧化氮（NO₂）数据联合同化的见解
items.summary_en: This study integrates satellite and surface NO2 measurements through the ensemble square root filter and the GEOS‐Chem model to estimate anthropogenic NOx emissions for China, the contiguous U.S., and Europe over 2019–2020, and further examines how the COVID‐19 pandemic altered emission patterns and sectoral contributions. Our results show that in 2020, anthropogenic NOx emissions were 19.20 ± 5.87 Tg in China, 8.96 ± 2.90 Tg in the contiguous U.S., and 10.56 ± 2.95 Tg in Europe. Compared with 2019, emissions decreased by about 5.38% in China, 8.94% in the contiguous U.S., and 15.38% in Europe. In China, emission reductions came from transportation, power plants, and industry. In contrast, reductions in the contiguous U.S. and Europe were almost entirely from transportation. These differences reflect the fundamental gap in energy structure and industry models between developed and developing economies. During the first wave of the pandemic, emissions fell sharply compared to the same period in 2019. The decreases were 18.04% in China, 10.56% in the contiguous U.S., and 21.74% in Europe. Large spatial variations were observed within each region. This work provides observation-based evidence of NOx emission changes across major world regions during COVID 19. It highlights how emissions can behave differently under sudden public health crises. The findings are useful for checking bottom-up emission inventories, assessing extreme events’ impacts on air quality, and designing better emission reduction policies.
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过集合平方根滤波器和GEOS-Chem模型，整合了卫星和地面NO₂观测数据，估算了2019–2020年期间中国、美国本土及欧洲的人为NOx排放量，并进一步探讨了新冠疫情如何改变了排放模式及各部门的排放贡献。 研究结果表明，2020年，中国的人为NOx排放量为19.20 ± 5.87 Tg，美国本土为8.96 ± 2.90 Tg，欧洲为10.56 ± 2.95 Tg。 与2019年相比，中国的排放量减少了约5.38%，美国本土减少了8.94%，欧洲减少了15.38%。 在中国，减排主要来自交通运输、发电厂和工业领域。相比之下，美国本土和欧洲的减排几乎完全来自交通运输领域。这些差异反映了发达经济体与发展中经济体在能源结构和产业模式上的根本性差距。 在疫情第一波期间，与2019年同期相比，排放量急剧下降。其中，中国下降了18.04%，美国本土下降了10.56%，欧洲下降了21.74%。 各区域内部均观察到显著的空间差异。本研究提供了关于新冠疫情期间全球主要地区氮氧化物（NOx）排放变化的观测证据，突显了在突发公共卫生危机下，排放行为可能呈现出的不同表现。这些研究结果有助于核查自下而上的排放清单、评估极端事件对空气质量的影响，以及制定更有效的减排政策。

items.title: Global meta-analysis and machine learning uncover region-specific salinity thresholds and risks for sustainable wheat production under saline irrigation
items.title_en: Global meta-analysis and machine learning uncover region-specific salinity thresholds and risks for sustainable wheat production under saline irrigation
items.title_zh: 全球荟萃分析与机器学习揭示了在盐渍灌溉条件下可持续小麦生产所面临的区域特异性盐度阈值及风险
items.summary_en: Saline irrigation represents a pivotal alternative strategy for enhancing crop production under freshwater scarcity. However, previous assessments have mainly quantified average yield responses, while how interacting environmental and management conditions shape region-specific irrigation-water salinity thresholds and associated spatial risks remain elusive across global major breadbaskets. This study combined a meta-analysis of 551 field observations with machine learning (ML) to quantify global wheat yield responses to saline irrigation, identify optimal region-specific thresholds, and evaluate spatial risks in four major wheat-producing areas: the North China Plain (NCP), Indo-Gangetic Plain (IGP), Middle East (ME), and Central California Valley (CCV). Meta-analysis revealed that saline irrigation led to significant average yield reductions ranging from 12.4% in the NCP to 31.4% in the CCV. ML further showed that irrigation water salinity, growing-season temperature, and irrigation amount emerged as the dominant drivers, collectively explaining more than 54% of yield variation. An optimum irrigation amount of 500 mm was optimal for maximizing yield under saline conditions. Region-specific best practices included border irrigation at flowering (FL) and grain-filling stages for the NCP, drip irrigation at these stages for the IGP, and drip irrigation at the FL stage for the ME and CCV. Spatial risk assessment revealed a mismatch between salinity tolerance thresholds and actual exposure. Under a conservative 5% yield-loss scenario, the IGP exhibited the highest model-derived salinity threshold of 4.14 dS m−1 but the largest risk area proportion due to elevated background salinity, whereas the ME faced the lowest risk, with a risk area of 7.7%, indicating high potential for saline water utilization. These findings highlight the limitations of universal water quality guidelines and demonstrate the necessity of localized management. By establishing a data-driven framework, this study provides actionable insights to safeguard global wheat supply, build climate resilience, and ensure agricultural sustainability in salt-affected environments.
items.summary_zh: 在淡水稀缺的情况下，盐水灌溉是提高作物产量的关键替代策略。然而，以往的研究主要量化了平均产量响应，而环境与管理条件如何相互作用，从而决定各地区特有的灌溉水盐度阈值及相关空间风险，这一问题在全球主要粮仓地区仍未明朗。 本研究将551项田间观测数据的荟萃分析与机器学习（ML）相结合，旨在量化全球小麦对盐渍灌溉的产量响应，确定各区域的最佳阈值，并评估四个主要小麦产区——华北平原（NCP）、 印度-恒河平原（IGP）、中东（ME）以及加利福尼亚中部谷地（CCV）。元分析结果表明，咸水灌溉导致平均产量显著下降，降幅从华北平原（NCP）的12.4%到加利福尼亚中部谷地（CCV）的31.4%不等。 ML进一步表明，灌溉水盐度、生长期温度和灌溉量是主要影响因素，共同解释了超过54%的产量变异。在盐渍条件下，500毫米的灌溉量是实现产量最大化的最优值。 各区域的特定最佳实践包括：NCP地区在开花（FL）和灌浆期采用边行灌溉；IGP地区在上述阶段采用滴灌；ME和CCV地区在开花期采用滴灌。空间风险评估揭示了盐分耐受阈值与实际暴露情况之间存在不匹配。 在保守的5%减产情景下，IGP区域的模型推导盐度阈值最高（4.14 dS m−1），但因背景盐度偏高，其风险区域比例最大；而ME区域面临的风险最低，风险区域仅占7.7%，表明该区域利用咸水的潜力巨大。 这些发现突显了通用水质指南的局限性，并证明了实施本地化管理是必要的。通过建立一个数据驱动的框架

items.title: NASA captures a stunning transformation in Australia's red outback

items.title_zh: 美国宇航局（NASA）捕捉到澳大利亚红色内陆地区令人惊叹的蜕变
items.summary_en: Australia's normally dry, rust-colored outback has erupted into a spectacular carpet of wildflowers after unusually heavy rains, potentially producing its most impressive bloom in nearly 20 years. NASA satellite images capture the stunning transformation, which has even brought rare flowers to the grounds of a remote deep-space observatory.

items.summary_en: Protesters spent months occupying an ancient cottonwood. Then a tense standoff with US border patrol came to a headA 200-year-old cottonwood tree near the US-Mexico border, known as the “grandmother”, has been destroyed to make way for the construction of Donald Trump’s border wall, despite a months-long effort by protesters trying to save it.In late July, land defenders began a tree-sit in the ghost town of Lochiel, Arizona, taking turns occupying a platform high in the tree’s canopy. items.title: Limited agricultural gains but high flood risk from global wetland reclamation
items.title_en: Limited agricultural gains but high flood risk from global wetland reclamation
items.title_zh: 全球湿地开垦带来的农业收益有限，但洪水风险较高
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 09 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01965-xAs food demand increases, global wetlands are being reclaimed as croplands; however, these reclaimed croplands are not only less productive, but also face substantially higher flood exposure. This dual vulnerability highlights the urgency of balancing food security with wetland conservation.
items.summary_zh: 《自然·可持续性》，在线发表于：2026年10月9日； doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01965-x随着粮食需求的增长，全球湿地正被开垦为农田；然而，这些开垦出的农田不仅产量较低，而且面临的洪涝风险也显著增加。 这种双重脆弱性凸显了在粮食安全与湿地保护之间寻求平衡的紧迫性。
